agent_explanation: Actuated NS green ran very long (~74s from ~step 251 to 324). When EW demand (W queue) appeared, the controller's actuated/recall switch cut NS yellow short: green at 324, yellow only at 325, red/all-red at 326, i.e. a 1s yellow instead of 3s. Fixed-time control of the identical scenario shows no violation, confirming the actuated termination path truncates yellow.
